name: baconservices-mcp
description: Pay-per-call image tools for agents, in USDC on Base over x402, with local spending limits.
long_description:
Let your agent remove backgrounds, optimize images for the web, read an image's colour palette, read a company's brand from its website and turn a logo into an SVG, without an account or API key. It pays per call in USDC on Base over x402, from your own wallet.

- `remove_background`: transparent PNG at the photo's size, 0.20 USDC
- `optimize_image`: resize + WebP, 0.01 USDC
- `image_palette`: an image's dominant colours as JSON, 0.01 USDC
- `brand_from_url`: a public web page's brand kit (name, logos, colours, fonts, social) as JSON, 0.03 USDC
- `vectorize_image`: a logo, icon or flat artwork traced into an SVG of flat-colour paths, 0.05 USDC
- `list_services`, `quote`, `wallet_status`: free

Prices come from Bacon's live catalog. Your key stays on your machine. Before any payment the server checks the price against Bacon's live catalog and verifies the payee. It enforces your per-call, per-session and daily limits; the daily limit persists across restarts. Where the client supports it, you're asked to approve each payment. Use a dedicated wallet holding only what you are willing to spend.

wallet_key_file.title: Wallet key file
wallet_key_file.description: A file holding the buyer wallet's private key (USDC on Base). Preferred: the key then never sits in the app's settings. Set this or the private key below, not both. Without either, only the free tools work.

wallet_private_key.title: Wallet private key
wallet_private_key.description: The buyer wallet's private key, if not using a key file. Use a dedicated wallet holding only what you are willing to spend.

max_per_session.title: Most per session (USDC)
max_per_session.description: Most this process may spend, in USDC.

max_per_day.title: Most per day (USDC)
max_per_day.description: Most spent in any rolling 24 hours, persisted across restarts, in USDC.

confirm.title: Ask before paying
confirm.description: auto, always or never: ask before each payment when the app can.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Everything Bacon sells right now, with prices, limits, and whether this version can run it. Free.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Bacon's current price for one service, and whether your limits and wallet allow it. Free.

tools.name: wallet_status
tools.description: The payment network, whether a wallet is configured, your spending limits and what is left of them, and whether the wallet can afford each service. Free.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Removes the background from one photo; a transparent PNG at the photo's size. Paid.

tools.name: optimize_image
tools.description: Resizes one image and encodes it as WebP. Paid.

tools.name: image_palette
tools.description: The colours one image is mostly made of, as JSON. Paid.

tools.name: brand_from_url
tools.description: Reads one public web page and returns its brand as JSON: name, logos, colours, fonts, social profiles. Paid.

tools.name: vectorize_image
tools.description: Traces one image into an SVG of flat-colour paths. Paid.
